media.title: Heut’ kommt’s drauf an (1933) — Illustrierter Film-Kurier, no. 1946
media.description: Cover of Illustrierter Film-Kurier, no. 1946, devoted to Heut’ kommt’s drauf an (1933), Kurt Gerron’s film with Hans Albers and music by Walter Jurmann and Bronisław Kaper. This is a film-program/periodical cover, not a standard theatrical poster.
media.altText: Illustrated Film-Kurier cover for Heut’ kommt’s drauf an, showing film-promotion artwork and issue text.
media.rightsNote: The linked source identifies this item as public domain or otherwise free of known copyright restrictions; attribution is retained.

media.title: Heut’ kommt’s drauf an (1933) — promotional sheet-music cover
media.description: Promotional cover for Heut’ kommt’s drauf an (1933), documenting the Bronisław Kaper–Walter Jurmann collaboration.
media.altText: Vintage promotional cover for “Heut’ kommt’s drauf an,” featuring Hans Albers.
media.rightsNote: The Walter Jurmann cover gallery documents this German promotional cover but supplies no open reuse licence. A graphic work published in Germany in 1933 remained protected on 1 January 1996, so United States copyright was restored under the URAA. The local image is classified as restricted.
media.publicCaption: Promotional cover for Heut’ kommt’s drauf an (1933), documenting the Bronisław Kaper–Walter Jurmann collaboration.
